pageCache.pageTitle: Pelham Primary School - Head of School's Welcome
pageCache.text:
Head of School's Welcome
I am extremely proud to be Head of school, and privileged to work alongside a very passionate, highly skilled team of staff who are committed to delivering excellence every day.
At Pelham Primary School, we believe that education is not just about academic achievement—it’s about nurturing confident, compassionate, and curious young people who are ready to thrive in an ever-changing world. We are incredibly proud of our vibrant school community, where every child is valued, supported, and challenged to reach their full potential.
We dream big. From the classroom to the playground, from sports fields to the arts, we encourage our pupils to be ambitious in their goals, courageous in their thinking, and determined in their efforts. Our dedicated staff work hard to create a learning environment of high expectations —ensuring that every child feels empowered to explore, discover, and grow.
Strong relationships lie at the heart of everything we do. Whether you’re a pupil, parent, staff member or visitor, you will find a welcoming, inclusive environment where respect, kindness, and collaboration are key. We place great importance on working together with families and the wider community to give our students the best possible foundation for life.
Thank you for taking the time to explore our school. We would be delighted to welcome you to Pelham Primary School to share with you the energy, enthusiasm, and excellence that define us. Please don’t hesitate to get in touch or arrange a visit—we’d love to show you around.
Please come and visit us at Pelham Primary School. We would love to see you!
Miss C Took Head of School

pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club/After School Club
Breakfast club
We are pleased that we are able to host our own daily Breakfast Club. We operate a booking system as this ensures that we have the right amount of food and staff - places are allocated on a 'first come, first served' basis.
Breakfast Club starts at 7.45am, if you would like your child to eat breakfast at school they must arrive by 8.15am.
Breakfast usually consists of:
We ask that you, where possible, book Breakfast Club in advance. You will need to complete a registration form initially, which you can obtain from the school office.
Once you have registered, you can use the booking link below, it costs £4.00 per session.
https://pmx.parentmail.co.uk/
a selection of cereals
a drink
After school club
We are please to offer our own daily after-school club which is run by our own staff from 3.15pm until 5.50pm, however you are welcome to collect before this time.
During after school club, pupils have access to a range of activities which cater for all interests, some of which include; outdoor sports, arts and crafts, watching a film, time to socialise with peers.

Once you have registered, you can use the booking link below, it costs £3 from 3:15 - 4:00 or £10.00 for a full session.

Little Dreamers
Welcome to Little Dreamers -
our 2-3 years nursery provision
We understand that every child deserves a place where they feel safe, loved and inspired to learn. Our nursery provides a warm, caring and stimulating environment where children are encouraged to explore, discover and develop through meaningful play and enriching experiences.
We believe that children thrive when they feel happy, secure and valued. That's why our experienced and dedicated team takes the time to build trusting relationships with every child and their family, creating a true partnership that supports each child's unique learning journey.
Our thoughtfully planned learning experiences encourage curiosity, creativity and independence while nurturing confidence, resilience and a lifelong love of learning. Whether children are making new friends, exploring the outdoors, expressing themselves through creative play or celebrating their latest achievements, every day is filled with opportunities to grow and flourish.
We are committed to giving every child the very best start in life. We celebrate every milestone, inspire every imagination and create a nurturing foundation where little minds can shine brightly and confidently take their next steps towards the future.
2 year old - 3 year olds
We are open all year (closing for 1 week at Christmas, Bank Holidays and Easter Weekend) Full Day: 8:00am-6:00pm Half Day AM: 8.00am-13:00pm
